en: Colorized view of a European town square labeled in three languages as King Ferdinand Square. In the center-right stands a long Baroque Roman Catholic church with an onion-domed bell tower; a lamppost rises in the square and early automobiles and horse-drawn carts are visible. On the left is an ornate Art Nouveau corner building. A tree with posters frames the foreground. The reverse names the city in Romanian, German, and Hungarian and carries Romanian postal instructions and the publisher/date.
